snippet.title: Five Nights at Freddy's GAMEBOY Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Five Nights at Freddy's GAMEBOY is back and BIT-ter than ever!  
Improved performance, graphics, and mechanics await you in the two-night demo, available to play at Itch.io and GameJolt!
